# Third-party notices

The training engines derive from the CellFlux/DiffusionBridge codebase.
The CellFlux MIT license is retained in `CELLFLUX_LICENSE.txt`. Source-level
upstream references and copyright notices are preserved, including those for
OpenAI ADM/guided-diffusion utilities, k-diffusion, and NVIDIA EDM augmentation.
The included corruption modules retain their original LICENSE files and headers.

PyTorch, torchvision, torch-fidelity and other dependencies are installed
separately and remain subject to their respective licenses. No third-party
weights or datasets are redistributed in this repository.
